title: Noodle fake-social-network mode (headline v2.2.0 feature)
reality: Noodle is a whole new mode alongside Conversation/Roleplay/Game: invited characters + optional random users create posts, nested replies, polls, images, likes, reposts, mentions, notifications on a persistent generated timeline; personas participate; auto/manual refresh scheduling; social-memory carryover into Conversation/Roleplay/Game; mobile shell. Server-backed at packages/server/src/routes/noodle.routes.ts; CHANGELOG L61. Absent from entire skill.
fix: Add a Noodle section to architecture.md as a fourth mode: timeline, posts/replies/polls/reposts/mentions/notifications, per-character Noodle profiles (handle/bio/location/avatar/banner), refresh scheduling, and social-memory carryover into other modes.

title: Noodle added to mode-selection guidance
reality: Noodle is a selectable persistent-timeline mode with persona participation and multi-character lorebook context (CHANGELOG L61,92). Decision-guide currently lists only Conversation/Roleplay/Game.
fix: Add Noodle to mode-selection: pick it for a persistent social timeline / multi-character social simulation vs Conversation/Roleplay/Game.

title: Noodle multimodal timeline context + optional vision captioning
reality: Refresh models inspect images on recent posts/comments with bounded inputs and a text-only fallback; optional captioning uses a separate selectable vision connection so text-only timeline models understand attached images (CHANGELOG L63-64, #3505).
fix: Document Noodle's multimodal refresh path and the optional vision/captioning connection for text-only timeline models.

title: Opt-in Noodle Lorebook context
reality: Opt-in (off by default) Noodle setting: timeline refreshes scan recent post/reply text and active character profiles for lorebook keyword matches, reusing the group-chat multi-character lorebook system with a Noodle-specific token budget scaling with active character count (CHANGELOG L92).
fix: Note in lorebooks.md that lorebooks also activate inside Noodle timeline refreshes (opt-in, off by default) with a per-active-character token budget.

title: Noodle Timeline Voice & Tone prompt override
reality: A registered prompt override (Settings -> Generations -> Image Generation Prompt Overrides) lets the tone/creative-freedom portion of Noodle's refresh prompt be user-rewritten while structured-action/output-format rules stay hardcoded (CHANGELOG L93).
fix: Add Noodle Timeline Voice & Tone to the documented list of prompt overrides.

title: Built-in agent count is now 22 (About Me Keeper added)
reality: agent-registry.generated.ts lists 22 BUILT_IN_AGENT_MANIFESTS (aboutMeKeeperAgentManifest is the 22nd, line 50). Manifest id 'about-me-keeper' (about-me-keeper/manifest.ts:4). It is Conversation-only opt-in via CONVERSATION_ALLOWED_AGENT_IDS=['about-me-keeper'] (chat-mode-capabilities.ts:89) and hidden from the Roleplay agents library (CHANGELOG L101, L182). Keeps a character's about-me current on a cadence, updating the public card profile via approval or a private chat-scoped one.
fix: Bump the count from 21 to 22 and add an About Me Keeper entry (Conversation-only, opt-in, updates public/private about-me via approval flow).

title: New opt-in update_about_me command
reality: Tool manifest name 'update_about_me' with scope enum ['public','chat'] + content string (function-calls/tools/update-about-me/manifest.ts:4-20); Conversation-mode only; scope 'public' = cross-chat bio needing user approval, 'chat' = private to that conversation (CHANGELOG L182).
fix: Document the opt-in update_about_me command: Conversation-only, public scope gated behind user approval, chat scope private.

title: Conversation-mode profile fields (convoDisplayName / aboutMe / convoBehavior)
reality: characterExtensionsSchema adds convoDisplayName, convoDisplayNameInCard, aboutMe, convoBehavior (convoBehaviorConfigSchema: instruction + insertionStrategy enum constant_before|constant_after|post_history_replace|post_history_before|post_history_after|macro, default constant_after), aboutMeSources (character.schema.ts:30-74). Conversation-mode-only, never sent in Roleplay/VN/Game. Personas carry the same profile columns, and Professor Mari persona.create / `mari personas create` now supply/accept them (CHANGELOG L180 #3368, L32 #3571).
fix: Add a Conversation-mode profile subsection covering convoDisplayName, aboutMe (AI-write + aboutMeSources), and convoBehavior insertion strategies, for both characters and personas.

title: Per-chat about-me overrides
reality: Discord per-server-profile style: click a participant avatar in Conversation mode to set/edit/clear a chat-specific about-me that supersedes the card default in that conversation (CHANGELOG L181). Pairs with update_about_me scope 'chat'.
fix: Note that Conversation about-me has a per-chat override layer distinct from the card default.

title: Conversation prompt-relocation + convo-profile macros
reality: macro-engine.ts:322-363 registers category 'Conversation' macros: relocation macros {{context}}/{{status}}, {{commands}}, {{reactRules}}, {{replyRules}}, {{memories}}, {{lorebook}} (each 'places the block here and skips its auto insertion') plus profile macros {{convo_display}}, {{char_about}}, {{persona_about}}, {{convo_behavior}} (CHANGELOG L185; note source also includes {{replyRules}}, not in changelog line).
fix: Add a Conversation macros list documenting the relocation macros and the convo-profile macros.

title: Convo display name: card toggle, live sender label, group-chat honoring
reality: A character may have a Convo display name distinct from card `name`. Optional per-character toggle declares it in the prompt so the model maps display name to card in group chats; it is shown as the live sender label above messages (CHANGELOG L84-85). Group Conversation now honors it in generation instructions, speaker parsing, labels, typing events, and base-name matching (CHANGELOG L44 #3550).
fix: Document the Convo display name (distinct from card name), the declare-in-prompt toggle, and the live sender-label behavior in group Conversation.

title: About-me AI-write configurable source picker
reality: A gear-icon source picker (card editor + in-chat popout) chooses which card fields (description/personality/scenario/backstory/appearance), the Convo behavior directive, lorebook entries (per-entry), and recent chat context feed the about-me AI-write draft; defaults to personality only (CHANGELOG L81; DEFAULT_ABOUT_ME_SOURCES={personality:true} character.schema.ts:136).
fix: Document the about-me AI-write source picker and its default (personality only).

title: mari-about-me-* Card CSS hooks + persona creator-notes CSS
reality: New mari-about-me-* hooks in the Card CSS Theming Guide make the Conversation about-me popout themable from Creator Notes; personas can now ship creator-notes CSS for their popout (CHANGELOG L183).
fix: Mention the mari-about-me-* Card CSS hooks and persona creator-notes CSS in the theming coverage.

title: Phonetic name field + phonetic macros
reality: Optional phoneticName field on Character/Persona; macros {{userNamePhonetic}} (macro-engine.ts:289) and {{charNamePhonetic}} (:306) fall back to {{user}}/{{char}} when empty; used to pronounce names in Conversation Call TTS (CHANGELOG L242, 2.1.1 #3325).
fix: Add a Phonetic name field to the character/persona field list and document {{charNamePhonetic}}/{{userNamePhonetic}} (fall back to {{char}}/{{user}}; used for TTS pronunciation).

title: Title / comment promoted to primary identity field
reality: Title/comment moved into the primary identity fields directly below Name in both Character and Persona Metadata, synced with the editor-header field (CHANGELOG L19).
fix: Add a Title/comment identity field below Name in the character/persona metadata description, noting it mirrors the editor-header field.

title: Conversation table-game command family expanded far beyond UNO
reality: turn-games registry has six engines: uno, chess, eightball (8-Ball Pool, real 2D physics sim, /8ball alias /pool, selectable announcer), poker (No-Limit Hold'em 2-8 players, seeded dealing, side pots, selectable character dealer, /poker), tic-tac-toe (/tictactoe alias /ttt), rock-paper-scissors (/rps best-of-N) — packages/shared/src/features/turn-games/. Each has a [command] token, slash command, NL launcher, per-chat toggle, setup modal (CHANGELOG L11,86-91). Skill only says 'Turn games (UNO)'.
fix: Broaden the turn-games note from UNO to the whole Conversation command family: [uno], [chess], [tic_tac_toe] (/ttt), [rock_paper_scissors] (/rps), [poker] (selectable dealer), [eightball] 8-Ball Pool (/8ball, /pool, physics sim, selectable announcer). Route /api/turn-games is still correct.

title: GLM-5.2 OpenAI-compatible model
reality: model-lists.ts:524 adds { id:'glm-5.2', context:1000000, maxOutput:128000 }; native Z.AI GLM-5.2 connections send documented thinking.type/reasoning_effort (CHANGELOG L79,150).
fix: Add GLM-5.2 (1M context / 128K output) to documented custom OpenAI-compatible model options.

title: OpenAI GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna support
reality: model-lists.ts:98-103 adds gpt-5.6 (Sol alias), gpt-5.6-sol, gpt-5.6-sol-pro, gpt-5.6-terra, gpt-5.6-luna (1.05M context / 128K output); Responses API routing, GPT-5.6 'max' reasoning-effort mapping, reuse of Exclude Past Reasoning toggle (CHANGELOG L80).
fix: Add GPT-5.6 Sol/Terra/Luna (with pro alias, Responses API, max reasoning effort) to documented model/connection support.

title: Grok 4.5 default for new xAI connections
reality: model-lists.ts:433 adds { id:'grok-4.5', context:1000000 } (plus grok-4.5-latest); new xAI connections prefill grok-4.5 (CHANGELOG L184). Skill names no default xAI model.
fix: Note that new xAI connections default to Grok 4.5 (1M context).

title: Grok CLI (Subscription) local-auth provider
reality: providers.ts:79-81 defines grok_subscription 'Grok CLI (Subscription)'; providers.ts:18 lists it in LOCAL_AUTH_PROVIDERS alongside openai_chatgpt and claude_subscription. Routes chat through a local `grok` CLI login for SuperGrok/X Premium+ users, no API key or base URL fields (CHANGELOG L223,231).
fix: Add Grok CLI (Subscription) to the provider list as a local-auth/CLI-login provider (no API key/base URL), grouped with ChatGPT/Claude Subscription.

title: Grok CLI now honors configured Max Context Window (was capped 32k)
reality: Grok CLI subscription prompts are delivered via --prompt-file instead of inline -p (fixes E2BIG); with the transport limit gone an explicitly configured Max Context Window is honored rather than silently capped at 32k (32k default unchanged) (CHANGELOG L143).
fix: Note that Grok CLI (Subscription) now honors an explicitly set Max Context Window (default stays a conservative 32k).

title: Per-category Connections Defaults / fallback
reality: A Defaults section in Connections lets Main, Agents, Illustrator, and Videos each set an optional fallback connection; failed generations retry once through it with a toast naming the fallback connection/model, while cancellations and already-streamed partials are protected (CHANGELOG L12; connection-fallback-provider).
fix: Add a note to the Connections section: each category (Main, Agents, Illustrator, Videos) can set a fallback connection retried once on failure.

title: World State & Present Character trackers: custom fields + hide/lock controls
reality: Both trackers now support user-defined custom fields and per-field hide controls with inline editing, lock-aware persistence, tracker-agent updates, and matching Tracker Panel / Roleplay HUD displays (CHANGELOG L66 #3518). Skill describes fixed built-in field sets only.
fix: Update the world-state/character-tracker entries to note user-addable custom fields and hide/lock controls in the Tracker Panel and HUD.

title: Per-agent manual scheduling for tracker agents
reality: Individual trackers can be excluded from automatic post-turn runs and triggered from the HUD, instead of an all-or-nothing suite-level manual mode (CHANGELOG L67 #3522).
fix: Note that tracker agents support per-agent manual scheduling (exclude individual trackers from auto runs, fire from HUD).

title: Tracker stat values may be structured objects
reality: Character/custom tracker stat values can be structured { name, value, max, color } objects (e.g. HP bars), normalized by rpg-stats; previously crashed the Present Characters tracker (CHANGELOG L34 #3563).
fix: Document that tracker stat values can be structured { name, value, max, color } objects, not only plain numbers/strings.

title: XML prompt-template overrides preserve literal contract tags
reality: XML agent prompt-template overrides keep literal contract tags such as <chat_summary> and <existing_entries> intact while still escaping macro-inserted values (CHANGELOG L43 #3548).
fix: Add a caution to the prompt-template override note: literal contract tags are honored verbatim; only macro-inserted values are escaped.

title: Advanced prompt controls now apply in Conversation + Game
reality: System Prompt, Post-History Instructions, and Depth Prompts inject across Roleplay, Conversation participants, and Game party/character-GM cards via a shared injection path in preset/direct/preview assembly (CHANGELOG L53). Skill implies Roleplay-only.
fix: Clarify that system_prompt/post_history_instructions/depth_prompt inject across Roleplay, Conversation participants, and Game party/character-GM cards.

title: Default Illustrator prompt now injects build/outfit/appearance
reality: Default Illustrator prompt rules updated so generated image prompts carry available character builds, clothing/outfits, and appearance details instead of relying on the image model to infer them (CHANGELOG L197).
fix: Note the v2.2 default Illustrator prompt now injects character build/outfit/appearance details.

title: Batch editing of Lorebook entries
reality: One boolean (recursion, case sensitivity, whole-word, vector exclusion, enabled) can be applied to thousands of selected entries in one atomic update (CHANGELOG L68 #3513).
fix: Document batch editing of Lorebook entries for bulk boolean toggles.

title: Vector search as keyword-miss fallback for keyed entries
reality: Semantic/vector similarity now acts as the documented fallback for ordinary keyed entries when keyword matching misses, retaining score thresholds, max results, filters, and probability gates (CHANGELOG L120 #3511).
fix: Clarify that vector search now serves as a fallback for keyed entries when keyword matching misses (subject to thresholds/filters).

title: Remove-from-card + Edit Embedded Lorebook rename
reality: The character Lorebook tab gained a 'Remove from card' action to unlink/clear an embedded lorebook (works even for cards with no linked copy); 'Edit Linked Lorebook' renamed 'Edit Embedded Lorebook' (CHANGELOG L259, 2.1.1 #3359).
fix: Note the 'Remove from card' detach action and the 'Edit Embedded Lorebook' rename.

title: Sort entries by entry status
reality: Lorebook entries can be sorted by entry status in the editor (CHANGELOG L255, 2.1.1 #3336).
fix: Mention that lorebook entries support sorting by entry status.

title: Regex ReDoS safety validator relaxed
reality: The regex safety validator now accepts linear delimiter-bounded field patterns such as ([^|]+)\|([^|]+)\|([^|]+) while still rejecting overlapping broad-unbounded (catastrophic-backtracking) chains (CHANGELOG L139 #3471).
fix: Add a note that regex scripts pass a ReDoS validator: linear delimiter-bounded patterns are allowed; overlapping broad-unbounded chains are rejected.

title: Server-backed extension storage APIs
reality: Extensions now have server-backed, cross-device storage APIs with validation and size limits plus client/server runtime helpers (CHANGELOG L70 #3524; extensions.routes.ts). Skill says localStorage only, not DB-integrated.
fix: Replace the localStorage-only guidance with the new server-backed extension storage APIs (validated, size-limited, syncs across devices).

title: Message-scoped Game state endpoint
reality: A message/swipe-scoped Game state route (gameStateStore.getByChatAndMessage) lets extensions/integrations retrieve the exact stored snapshot for a selected chat message and swipe (CHANGELOG L71 #3526).
fix: Document the message-scoped Game state endpoint extensions can query for a specific chat message + swipe snapshot.

title: Extensions moved to Settings -> Addons
reality: Settings reorganized so a single 'Addons' tab combines Themes and Extensions (SettingsPanel; CHANGELOG L228, 2.1.1). Skill points users to 'Settings -> Extensions'.
fix: Update navigation from 'Settings -> Extensions' to 'Settings -> Addons -> Extensions'.

title: New media presets (Anime Episode / Comic Page Animation+Video) + keyframe macro
reality: v2.2 adds Comic Page Animation and Comic Page Video storyboard prompts plus an Anime Episode presentation (Anime Game Prompt / Anime Episode Director / Anime Game Video), setup-time keyframe targeting, and a {{gameStoryboardKeyframeCount}} GM macro (CHANGELOG L77-78,103). Skill's built-ins list omits these.
fix: Update the media-preset built-ins list to add Comic Page Animation, Comic Page Video, and the Anime Episode preset family, and add {{gameStoryboardKeyframeCount}} to the documented GM macros.

title: Visual Novel tab removed; legacy VN chats under Roleplay
reality: The obsolete Visual Novel coming-soon tab was removed; legacy/imported VN chats are grouped under Roleplay (schema/importer/achievements preserved); Game dialogue labels now use 'Dialogue Box' wording (CHANGELOG L106). Skill references VN as a current parallel surface.
fix: Note that Visual Novel is no longer a separate mode/tab; legacy VN chats appear under Roleplay (galleries still shared).

title: Game Mode Session History additions
reality: Session History gained an Initial Game Setup .txt export, per-turn Peek Prompt (exact cached prompt sent), read-only deterministic replay of completed sessions, and visible setup progress with elapsed timer (CHANGELOG L73-76, #3465 #3495).
fix: Document Game Mode Session History additions: Initial Game Setup export, per-turn Peek Prompt, and read-only session replay.

title: Discord-style :shortcode: emoji + autocomplete in Conversation
reality: Conversation supports Discord-style standard emoji shortcodes with autocomplete (e.g. :crying: renders Unicode, :cry... suggestions) alongside custom emoji (CHANGELOG L69 #3515).
fix: Note Conversation supports Discord-style :shortcode: emoji with autocomplete alongside custom emoji.

title: Roleplay Chat Summary max output size setting
reality: A Roleplay Chat Summary maximum output size setting under Summary Connection defaults to 4096 tokens for manual and automatic summaries (prompt.schema.ts:42 maxTokens default 4096; CHANGELOG L187).
fix: Mention the Summary Connection max-output-size setting (default 4096 tokens).

title: Custom Roleplay summary prompt is now global
reality: Custom Roleplay Chat Summary prompts now apply globally across all roleplay chats instead of only the currently open chat (CHANGELOG L198).
fix: Note that a custom Roleplay summary prompt is global, not per-open-chat.

title: Scene prompt setup dialog (POV/tense/wishes)
reality: A scene prompt setup dialog for user- and character-initiated scenes remembers POV, tense, and optional prompt wishes for the next scene generation (CHANGELOG L189).
fix: Mention the scene setup dialog (persisted POV/tense/prompt wishes) for scene generation.

title: Settings navigation reorganized (search-first, Overall Generations, Quick replies moved)
reality: Settings reworked with search-first navigation, compact pinned controls, fixed top-level categories; a new Overall Generations group holds media queueing/prompt-review with the option renamed 'Queue media generation requests' (now covers video); image prompt review is a global preference; Quick replies moved from Advanced to General -> Input & Editing (CHANGELOG L21,153,196).
fix: Refresh any Settings navigation references: search-first Settings, Overall Generations group, image-prompt-review as a global preference, and Quick replies under General -> Input & Editing.

title: Server generation route split into focused modules
reality: The server generation route was split into focused prompt, provider, context, and command-runtime modules so Conversation commands, Professor Mari actions, turn games, provider setup, and post-processing are separated (CHANGELOG L230, 2.1.1). Relevant to the skill's CONTRIBUTION guidance on where generation logic lives.
fix: For contribution guidance, note generation logic is now split into prompt/provider/context/command-runtime modules rather than one route file.

title: Connected-chat shortcut between Conversation and Game
reality: Game mode gained a connected-chat shortcut so connected Conversation and Game chats can switch back and forth like Conversation/Roleplay links (CHANGELOG L188).
fix: Note Game mode supports connected-chat switching with a linked Conversation chat (like Conversation/Roleplay links).

title: Stable-line marker is now 2.2.1 (was 2.1)
reality: Release metadata bumped to v2.2.1 across packages, PWA manifest, README pointer, installer sources; Android versionName 2.2.1 / versionCode 33 (CHANGELOG L24-25). SKILL.md still marks the 2.1 stable line (e.g. lines 139, 173, 'does feature X exist in 2.1 yet?').
fix: Update the stable-line marker from 2.1 to 2.2.1 in SKILL.md and any 'as of 2.1' phrasing.

title: Professor Mari suggestion chips / guided creation
reality: Home Mari and legacy Mari chats surface color-coded suggestion chips and guided creation follow-ups for step-by-step creation, editing, and contextual next actions (CHANGELOG L82).
fix: Note that Professor Mari now offers color-coded suggestion chips / guided creation follow-ups.

title: Noodle tuning settings (Enhanced tone & continuity, Images/refresh)
reality: Additional Noodle settings: opt-in 'Enhanced tone & continuity' (Settings -> Timeline Writing, off by default) grounds each account's voice in its own Personality/Description/Backstory and encourages cross-post reactions; the generated-image quota changed from a daily cap to 'Images/refresh'; character folders can be bulk-invited; setting refreshes/day to 0 disables automation (CHANGELOG L95,102,111).
fix: When documenting Noodle, mention the Enhanced tone & continuity opt-in, the per-refresh image quota, folder bulk-invite, and disabling automation via refreshes/day = 0.
